mapper.select: SELECT v.outpatientVolume, d.doctorRatioNum, d.doctorRatioDen, r.receptionRateNum, v.outpatientVolume AS receptionRateDen, o.prescriptionRateNum, o.prescriptionRateDen, o.recordRateNum, o.recordRateDen, o.reviewRateNum, o.reviewRateDen, o.executionRateNum, o.executionRateDen FROM ( SELECT COUNT(1) AS outpatientVolume FROM powerihsp_register_oder ro JOIN public_order_master om ON ro.order_id = om.order_id WHERE ro.out_date >= #{startDate} AND ro.out_date < #{endDate} + 1 AND ro.order_status != 5 ) v, ( SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN open_online_consultaation = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS doctorRatioNum, COUNT(1) AS doctorRatioDen FROM powerrsp.rsp_doctor_info ) d, ( -- 接诊率分子：同门诊量口径，ro.order_status<2为未接诊，故取>=2 SELECT COUNT(1) AS receptionRateNum FROM powerihsp_register_oder ro JOIN public_order_master om ON ro.order_id = om.order_id WHERE ro.out_date >= #{startDate} AND ro.out_date < #{endDate} + 1 AND ro.order_status >= 2 ) r, ( SELECT SUM(prescription_rate_num) AS prescriptionRateNum, SUM(prescription_rate_den) AS prescriptionRateDen, SUM(record_rate_num) AS recordRateNum, SUM(record_rate_den) AS recordRateDen, SUM(review_rate_num) AS reviewRateNum, SUM(review_rate_den) AS reviewRateDen, SUM(execution_rate_num) AS executionRateNum, SUM(execution_rate_den) AS executionRateDen FROM tr_inet_hosp_ov WHERE stat_date >= #{startDate} AND stat_date < #{endDate} + 1 ) o
SELECT item_name AS itemName, current_value AS currentValue, last_value AS lastValue, growth_rate AS growthRate FROM TR_INET_HOSP_OP WHERE stat_month = #{statMonth} ORDER BY item_name
SELECT category, current_value AS currentValue, last_value AS lastValue FROM TR_INET_HOSP_BIZ WHERE stat_month = #{statMonth} ORDER BY category

SELECT ROWNUM AS rankNum, deptName, currentMonth, lastMonth FROM ( SELECT ro.dept_name AS deptName, SUM(CASE WHEN ro.out_date >= #{startDate} AND ro.out_date < #{endDate} + 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS currentMonth, SUM(CASE WHEN ro.out_date >= #{lastStartDate} AND ro.out_date < #{lastEndDate} + 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lastMonth FROM powerihsp_register_oder ro WHERE ro.out_date >= #{lastStartDate} AND ro.out_date < #{endDate} + 1 AND ro.order_status >= 2 GROUP BY ro.dept_code, ro.dept_name ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN ro.out_date >= #{startDate} AND ro.out_date < #{endDate} + 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC )

SELECT ROWNUM AS rankNum, doctorName, deptName, title, currentMonth FROM ( SELECT ro.doctor_name AS doctorName, ro.dept_name AS deptName, ro.doctor_title AS title, COUNT(1) AS currentMonth FROM powerihsp_register_oder ro WHERE ro.out_date >= #{startDate} AND ro.out_date < #{endDate} + 1 AND ro.order_status >= 2 GROUP BY ro.doctor_code, ro.doctor_name, ro.dept_name, ro.doctor_title ORDER BY COUNT(1) DESC )

SELECT category, dataValue FROM ( SELECT ro.dept_name AS category, ROUND(AVG((ro.reception_time - ro.create_time) * 1440), 0) AS dataValue FROM powerihsp_register_oder ro WHERE ro.out_date >= #{startDate} AND ro.out_date < #{endDate} + 1 AND ro.order_status >= 2 AND ro.reception_time IS NOT NULL AND ro.create_time IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ro.dept_code, ro.dept_name ORDER BY AVG((ro.reception_time - ro.create_time) * 1440) DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 20
